[INTRADISP · 2024–2026]{.code}

### [Intraspecific dispersal variation in European birds](intradisp.qmd)

Why do individuals of the same species disperse so differently? This project synthesises intraspecific dispersal variation using European bird ringing data to improve predictions of biodiversity responses to global change.

Role
:   Principal investigator

Host
:   UCM

Team
:   David Notario (MSc student & researcher); collaborators at Potsdam University and BTO

[RIMed-Fauna · 2024–2027]{.code}

### [Wildlife in Mediterranean river ecosystems](remined.qmd)

Mediterranean rivers are extreme environments: flooding in winter, bone-dry in summer. How does terrestrial wildlife cope with this variability, and how will climate change affect these dynamics?

Role
:   Team member

PI
:   María del Mar Sánchez-Montoya

Funder
:   Red de Parques Nacionales

Team
:   Claudia Mediavilla (MSc student & researcher) and others
:::
